fills.researcher_notes: First-party primary source: GIGL's own EOI letter to PNGRB, on GSPL India Gasnet Limited letterhead, ref GIGL/COMM/2020, dated 17 September 2020, signed by CEO Ravindra Agrawal. Verbatim: 'Sub: Submission of Expression of Interest (EOI) for Laying, Building and Operating Natural Gas Pipeline from Langtala (Jaisalmer District, Rajasthan) to Pachpadra (Barmer District, Rajasthan)... Focus Energy Limited is expecting production of 4 MMSCMD gas from its gas field in Langtala, Jaisalmer District. In order to connect the said gas source to the national gas grid... GIGL is hereby submitting Expression of Interest (EOI) under regulation 4(1)... The approximate length of the pipeline will be around 290 kms.' This directly confirms: (1) GIGL -- matching the sheet's existing Owner value -- is the entity proposing to lay/build/OPERATE the line, so Operator=GIGL is correct alongside the existing Owner=GIGL; (2) Focus Energy's role here is strictly as the upstream gas-field owner supplying feedstock, not as pipeline operator (the same field-vs-pipeline distinction that resolves P1436/P0936 in this brief); (3) length (~290 km) and capacity (4 MMSCMD) both match the sheet's LengthKnownKm (290.00) and Capacity (4.00 MMSCMD) exactly, so no length concern on this row. Treating as tier=medium (single document, though first-party/primary rather than press reporting, so stronger than a typical single source) -- did not find a second independent source naming GIGL specifically as operator; PNGRB's own bid-tracker page for this tender (pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/ng-bid-16.html, 'Langtala - Pachpadra Natural Gas Pipeline (LPPL)', publicly confirms the tender existed and was annulled per 'Public Notice for Annulment of Bid No. BID/NGPL/16/2020/01/LPPL') corroborates the project/cancellation facts but likewise does not print the sponsor's name on the regulator's tracker page itself. Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org. Operator is written 'GSPL India Gasnet Ltd (GIGL)' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'GSPL India Gasnet Ltd'. the acronym GIGL is kept as an alias.
